headings.quote: Now it came to pass in the days when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Beth-lehem-judah went to sojourn in the country of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.
headings.note: Dated only “in the days when the judges ruled”; no judge is named.

david-rut-4-17.name: David
david-rut-4-17.title: King of Judah, then of all Israel
